summary: Find the sparse nonzero, non-cyan square key. Its cyan companion is the key occupancy mask rotated 90 degrees clockwise and expanded into uniform logical tiles. Preserve the key and replace each cyan cell with the color of the corresponding clockwise-rotated key cell.
